text:
maria: OK team — quick sync: v2 change list for this sprint landed on the prod branch. Need owners to confirm canary readiness + SDK bump plan. Can we confirm by EOD Thu? TL;DR: header-based routing opt-in, remove /v1/legacy reroute in next release, and a minor schema rename (request.metadata -> request.meta).

jonathan: @maria thanks — SDK team: we have an open PR to add header opt-in but it pulls in an http-client patch. PR #4621. ETA for review is tomorrow. Is the schema rename backwards-compatible?

priya: @jonathan schema rename is additive on the server side; for safety servers accept both fields for two weeks and emit a deprecation warning in responses. We've added compatibility middleware in hosted and dedicated.

sam: Owners — who will drive the deprecation announcement? Marketing needs the copy for docs + console banner.

eva: @maria I can own docs + console banner. Will draft and post a preview in #docs by Wed.

maria: Thanks @eva. @priya can you open a migration test set with 5 representative prompts? We want smoke coverage for tokenization, embeddings, and function-calling.

priya: On it. Creating the test set and hooking up an eval job. Ticket INF-8893.

jonathan: SDK notes: we need to bump the OpenAPI spec and publish SDK 1.4.0. Canary plan: 24h global with 10% traffic, then regional canaries at 3%. @deploy-scheduler do we have infra reserved?

deploy-scheduler: deploy-scheduler: Canary window reserved for v2-surge: 2024-04-11 18:00 UTC -> 2024-04-12 18:00 UTC. Reserved slot: infra-3. CPU/GPU load checks scheduled.

sam: We have the slot. Need grooming of fallback policies before traffic flips. @maria please confirm fallback rule: route to v1-compatible model when latency > 250ms or 503.

maria: Confirmed. Fallback policy is in place: automatic routing to v1-compatible models for 503/latency breaches. We'll monitor via the console dashboards and page if error rate > 5% sustained for 10m.

jonathan: Reviewers needed on SDK PRs: @alex and @mina — can you review #4621 and #4630? They touch Java and Python clients.

alex: Looking now, will post comments by EOD.

priya: Also note SDK header opt-in key: `x-redwood-v2-optin: true`. Please ensure the Go client exposes this as Options.V2OptIn and the Python client has Client(v2_opt_in=True).

jonathan: Adding to changelog and migration guide snippet: `curl -H 'x-redwood-v2-optin: true' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate`

eva: :eyes: Draft banner uploaded. Will post preview in #docs at 2024-04-10 16:00 UTC.

maria: Final ask: owners list for follow-ups — API: @priya, SDK: @jonathan, Docs: @eva, Infra: @sam. I'll consolidate into the rollout checklist and ping migration leads.

priya: :thumbsup: Adding the test matrix to INF-8893 and linking it to the rollout checklist.

jonathan: I'll cut an SDK RC and publish release notes once the PRs merge. ETA Fri morning PT.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. If blockers pop up, DM me directly. :shipit:
